newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa stocks end weak as rate cut hopes dwindle.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa stocks end weak as rate cut hopes dwindle.

text.p: 1420 GMT - South African shares end weak as hopes of an early interest rate cut fade. Gold shares end off lows but softer overall as they ignore a firmer bullion price.

* Dealers said futures players dominate trade as they cut long positions, putting pressure on equities. Volumes traded light. The market is seen soft next week with occasional bounces after the GDP figure.
* Bookovers in Sappi and Iscor boost volumes. Sappi ends down 50 cents to 41 rand and Iscor rises two cents to 303 cents.
* Industrials drop 77.7 points, or 0.93 percent, to 8,240.2, golds lose 7.8 points to 1,173.8 and all-shares down 53.0 points to 7,021.7.
